stem: Which statement BEST explains the brief popularity of Vietnam War–related songs?

options.label: A
options.text: These songs became popular after U.S. withdrawal from the conflict began.

options.label: B
options.text: These songs peaked in sales as the anti-war movement intensified.

options.label: C
options.text: These songs topped the music charts during the early years of the conflict.

options.label: D
options.text: These songs were used to recruit U.S. soldiers during the de-escalation period of the conflict.

visual_elements: Bar graph titled 'Vietnam War–Related Songs in the Top 100, 1960–1975' showing number of singles for years 1960, 1965, 1970, 1975: 1960 has about 3 singles, 1965 has 10 singles, 1970 has 19 singles, 1975 has 1 single.
notes: The question includes a bar graph illustrating the popularity of songs related to the Vietnam War between 1960 and 1975.
